actions.name: IdTextbox_TextChanged
actions.purpose: Looks up the typed ID among categories, products, support definitions and policies

context.scope: Action started by a person in the FindById screen of Finding and browsing policies: Looks up the typed ID among categories, products, support definitions and policies
rules: When an ID is typed in Find by ID, the selected policy, category, product and support are cleared before the lookup, but the user or computer section choice is not, so an earlier section stays held after a different or no match. It matters only for a selected policy. (PolicyPlus/FindById.vb:22)
Text changes in Find by ID are ignored until the dialog has been given a definitions workspace, and the starting single space is cleared when it first appears. (PolicyPlus/FindById.vb:23)

When an ID is typed in Find by ID, only surrounding spaces are ignored and the ID must match letter case exactly. It is looked up as category, then product, then support definition, then policy; the first kind found is selected. (PolicyPlus/FindById.vb:28)
When the typed ID is not a category, product or support definition, text after the first '@' is cut off before the policy lookup, so 'ID@U' finds the same policy as 'ID'. (PolicyPlus/FindById.vb:41)

When a policy is found and the ID ends in '@U' it is selected for the User section, '@C' for the Computer section; with no suffix or any other suffix it is selected for both sections. (PolicyPlus/FindById.vb:44)
When the typed ID matches nothing, a not-found icon is shown, or a blank icon if the box is empty; no selection is made. (PolicyPlus/FindById.vb:50)
